decision: Accept the fixed factorized-attention plus rank-935 residual output span as positive held-out layer-1 representation evidence. The final prediction did not call the source MLP, every preregistered gate passed, and the host artifact remained unchanged. Do not certify Phase 3: validation uses direct residual coefficients and no executable coefficient generator or host operator exists. Authorize exactly one preregistered realizable compact coefficient-path experiment behind the fixed factorized attention.
claim_boundary: Positive compact layer-1 representation-span evidence only; direct validation coefficients, no installed coefficient generator or attention operator, and no model, physical runtime, autonomous, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
